observed_owner_boundaries: fs native provides only tool operations. tool.read registers an invocation and observes its digest internally; it returns line-numbered/truncated text without a complete source reference. Sessions touch is called only when Outcome.changed is Some (mutations), not on read.
sessions list returns complete Session records including agent/files/mailbox metadata; no private/scope filter in that list path.
pty readonly read/commands/screen/viewport/frame contain terminal output or command data; no metadata-only status operation.
router routes projects route id/model/provider/context/tier; status includes connection and health state.
live context aggregates agent tools and memo graph/landscape then tasks/ring; it is a context consumer, not a bounded evidence contributor.
memo shared context currently implements documents and memory only.
inventory currently joins tracked names and generation/state only, without file-body freshness or capability keys.
pending_design: Coordinate explicit owner adapters and native facade split; preserve source authority/privacy and avoid broad state scrapes. No source edits performed.
